message.text:
**Landed.** Pick a stacking style on [/framework/ux/Content/](/framework/ux/Content/) (bottom of the page) or on its own page [/framework/ux/Content/Disclosure/](/framework/ux/Content/Disclosure/).

- [x] no padding on the three-column area: it now sits on the page's padded track and spreads to three columns at 1920 (shot seen; used the existing `wide` word, no new rule; no separate before shot taken)
- [x] a summary that accepts any content, white, full width, on native details: `Disclosure` (title, icon + title, or a line; body is markdown or any drawn content)
- [x] stacking styles side by side: `faq` (gap, each rounded), `flush` (one rounded box, dividers), `lines` (no boxes, rules). One class on the stack, no per-item CSS
- [x] on the Content page and in its readme index; placeable by one page.jsonl line

Left: no Next/Next walkthrough (the Content page is the one-screen demo); your pick of style decides which one becomes the default. Source: [Disclosure.js](/framework/ux/Content/Disclosure/Disclosure.js), styles in content.css. Not committed or merged yet.
